summary: Top-performing Human Resources Professional with 10+ years of experience providing innovative and results-driven leadership within small and large organizations. Proven ability to effectively communicate with staff on all corporate levels, create and inspire positive relationships, and build solid teams of professional employees.

experience.title: HR Manager
responsibilities: Provided strategic direction and design in talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, and training design.
Aligned talent acquisition strategies with practice concentrations and subject matter needs.
Managed recruitment, retention, and performance management processes.
Served as Director – Talent Assimilation on the Leadership Team.
Led succession planning and trained leaders in human capital and organizational change strategies.

experience.title: Manager – HR Corporate Recruiter and HR Consultant
responsibilities: Coordinated full‑cycle recruiting and retention for management positions nationwide.
Partnered with hiring managers on interview and selection processes.
Developed corporate recruiting policies and implemented the first applicant tracking system.
Reduced turnover by 20% overall and 35% in the Chicago region.
Created vendor management system and negotiated contracts.
Led selection advisory and improved communication via an E‑Fax system.

experience.title: Sr. HR Generalist/Lead Recruiting Manager
responsibilities: Supported HR and recruitment for a placement firm with 1,500 employees.
Oversaw marketing of HR opportunities and recruitment of qualified candidates.
Designed new databases and internet search modalities for passive and active candidates.
Managed EEOC, FSLA, ADA, FMLA, benefits, payroll, and new‑hire orientation.
Implemented performance management, compensation, and terminations.

experience.title: Employee Relations Generalist
responsibilities: Managed HR operations across 30 facilities for 1,700 employees.
Handled employee relations, FMLA, EEOC, ADA, FSLA, benefits, and payroll.
Directed hiring managers on policies, procedures, and performance management.
Contributed to applicant tracking system development and policy guide creation.
Developed employee wellness and referral bonus programs and managed a $2M budget.
